text:
frank (design): dropped a compact mock for the 'new-integration' form. main asks: 1) when should we show validation (onChange/onBlur/onSubmit), 2) how explicit should required markers be in dense rows, 3) best destructive confirmation for deleting integrations with downstream bindings. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/integration-form leah (product): onboarding needs lower friction; prefer gentle onChange hints and authoritative errors onSubmit. For bulk deletes we want to avoid accidental removals but also not slow down power users. omar (eng): implementation constraints: uniqueness checks are server-side; debounce onChange checks to 400ms. layout-shift is real if we insert messages; reserve space or animate height. Also prefer using aria attributes rather than visible-only marks for semantics. mira (a11y): accessibility notes: asterisk-only is ambiguous. Use aria-required=\"true\" and include visible text when space allows. For validation: non-blocking hints -> aria-live=\"polite\"; blocking errors -> role=\"alert\" and aria-invalid on inputs. Example snippet for blocking error: ```html
Endpoint URL seems invalid
``` Also, if we have icon-only indicators in dense rows, ensure they have aria-label and keyboard focus. frank (design): proposal: three display modes - dense rows: tiny suffix "(req)" + icon-only validation that expands on focus; standard form: small "Required" helper under field; onboarding wizard: explicit label + friendly error copy. Will mock all three. leah (product): delete confirmation options: A) toast undo for <=15 items, B) modal with checkbox confirm for 16-250, C) typed-confirm for >250 or org-scoped deletes. We should show sample affected resources (max 5) and count. omar (eng): tech notes: toast-undo depends on soft-delete retention; checkbox is cheap; typed-confirm needs server-side verify on a stable id (not display name). Also ensure modal content is lazy-loaded to avoid blocking render on the form page. mira (a11y): typed-confirm can be a blocker for assistive tech users. Always provide an alternative (checkbox + confirm button) and ensure typed input has clear aria-label and autocomplete off. Avoid expecting exact casing if not needed. frank (design): copy recs for modal (concise + actionable): header: "Delete integration ‘stripe-prod’ and 8 linked jobs" body: "This action permanently removes these items. You can restore from Trash within 30 days." primary CTA: "Delete integration" (red). For typed-confirm placeholder: "Type INTEGRATION-ID to confirm". Avoid vague "Are you sure?" alone. leah (product): +1. Add an experiment: A/B test toast-undo vs checkbox-modal for 50-200 deletes; metrics: accidental-delete rate, restore rate, action completion time. omar (eng): performance ask: if we show inline errors with icons across many rows, use an SVG sprite and CSS-only transitions to keep repaint cheap. qa-bot: checklist: accessibility tests required for keyboard focus, screen reader flow, and contrast. Add automated e2e for undo behavior. frank (design): action items: 1) I'll update Figma with three density mocks and the modal variants, 2) add aria notes and the code snippet, 3) draft A/B plan and metrics. tagging @mira and @omar for quick reviews when done. :sparkles: leah (product): thanks — please ping when ready and include copy variants (friendly/error/helpful) so we can sanity-check localization impact.
